summary: Wired Datasette startup into the ASGI lifespan protocol. Added _startup_sequence() to Datasette — a lock-guarded, idempotent entry point that does the immutable-database table_counts precompute and invoke_startup(), checking both _startup_invoked and _setup_db_done so a bare invoke_startup() first still leaves precompute pending. Set self._setup_db_done and self._startup_lock in __init__ (both branches). Removed the setup_db local in app(); wrapped the ASGI app with AsgiLifespan(on_startup=[self._startup_sequence]) then AsgiRunOnFirstRequest(on_startup=[self._startup_sequence]). Added try/except around startup/shutdown hook loops in AsgiLifespan, emitting lifespan.startup.failed / shutdown.failed on exception. Gave AsgiRunOnFirstRequest an asyncio.Lock, passing lifespan scopes through and blocking concurrent first requests until startup finishes. Updated datasette serve to call ds._startup_sequence().
